segments.name: Rent guarantee services
segments.description: Provides rent guarantee services to UK landlords for stable rental income and operates an AI software platform for property managers.
segments.evidence: RentBuddyUK is a company that specializes in rent guarantee services designed to provide landlords with stable and predictable rental income.
